english_source_note: Uniform Distribution mod 1 and Weyl's Criterion
statement_en: If $f\in C(\mathbb{T}\to \mathbb{C})$, then for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists a polynomial $P_{\varepsilon}(z)$ such that $$\|f-P_{\varepsilon}\|_{u}<\varepsilon.$$
callout_body: $f\in C(\mathbb{T}\to \mathbb{C})$那么对任意的$\varepsilon>0$存在一个多项式$P_{\varepsilon}(z)$使得$$||f-P_{\varepsilon}||_{u}<\varepsilon$$
